known_limitations: right-facing rows are mirrored from left-facing source art
walk frames contain limited foot articulation and use small positional bobbing
hurt is synthesized from idle poses because no dedicated hurt sheet was generated
generated source art includes baked contact shadows
up-facing defeat turns partially side-on during collapse
source_note: 48x48-cell transport canary used only to validate stage selection and source-cell remapping. Final authored pack must use 128x128 cells and remove baked shadows.
